blocks.text: Team preview of the Atlanta Hawks ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 46-36, lost to the Knicks in the first round of playoffs. Coach: Quin Snyder (sixth season, 13th overall, 505-399) Season opener: Oct. 21 at Orlando. Departures: F Zaccharie Risacher, F Jonathan Kuminga, G Buddy Hield, PG Gabe Vincent, C Christian Koloko, C Tony Bradley. Additions: G Luguentz Dort, G Aaron Wiggins, F Dorian Finney-Smith, G Kingston Flemings, F Zuby Ejiofor, Henri Veesaar.
